about: Integration specialist with roughly a decade of experience wiring disparate systems together so they behave like one. I enjoy the unglamorous work of mapping fields, taming flaky APIs, and making sure data lands where it should without surprises.
job_expectations: Looking for a role where integration work is treated as a first-class engineering problem, with room to standardize patterns rather than fight one-off fires.
hobbies: Restoring vintage bicycles and long weekend hikes.

experiences.description: Own the integration platform connecting our commerce, billing, and fulfillment systems, and set the standards other teams build against. I led a migration off a brittle point-to-point setup toward a documented, event-driven approach that cut failed handoffs dramatically.

Delivered partner integrations for a logistics platform, handling everything from auth handshakes to retry and reconciliation logic. I built a shared connector toolkit that turned multi-week onboarding into a few days for each new partner.

Built and maintained data-sync flows between internal CRM and finance systems. I introduced contract tests at the integration boundaries, which caught breaking schema changes before they reached production.

Coordinated integrations across several legacy services during a platform consolidation. I documented the undocumented interfaces and untangled a handful of circular dependencies that had blocked earlier attempts.
Supported message-queue and file-based integrations between back-office systems. I owned the monitoring dashboards and gradually reduced the volume of silent failures the team had grown used to.

Handled day-to-day support for inbound and outbound data interfaces, triaging failures and coordinating fixes with upstream providers. I built a runbook that let the support rotation resolve common breakages without escalating.

projects.title: Unified Provisioning Gateway
projects.summary: Built a central integration gateway that orchestrated provisioning across several cloud services for a hosting product. I designed the pipeline so each environment promotion was automated and auditable, and added the messaging layer that decoupled the slow upstream calls.
